author: Insta360
description:
We brought a group of creators to Malta, "the land of honey," to capture some sweet content for Insta360 Legends Week. It was an adrenaline-fueled community experience set against the island's stunning Mediterranean coastline and historic landscapes.

Top creators from around the world captured Malta in full 360, from cliff diving into crystal-clear waters and exploring sea caves to scaling rugged limestone cliffs, soaring across zip lines, and sailing along the coast. Beyond the action, the week was filled with unforgettable moments: sunset gatherings, shared stories, and the vibrant energy of creators connecting and creating together.

Watch our recap to see how Insta360 Legends Week in Malta pushes creativity without limits.

A huge thank you to all participating creators for bringing the energy and vision, and to our partners for making this experience possible. Special thanks to @haydenbsmith for capturing the spirit of the week 🔥
